title: Phnom Penh International Half Marathon 2027 Review: What the 2026 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Phnom Penh International Half Marathon 2027 Review
meta_description: Phnom Penh International Half Marathon review: almost 6,000 runners for the 14th edition on 14 June 2026, held to mark the Queen Mother's 90th birthday.
dek: Cambodia's capital held its 14th international half marathon on 14 June 2026, with almost 6,000 runners. Here is what that edition was like, ahead of 2027.
verdict: The Phnom Penh International Half Marathon is an established international road race in the capital. The 14th edition, on 14 June 2026, drew almost 6,000 Cambodian and international runners, and was held to mark the 90th birthday of Queen Mother Norodom Monineath Sihanouk [1]. Senior Minister Thong Khon, chairman of the National Olympic Committee of Cambodia, presided [1]. If you want a half marathon in Phnom Penh with official backing and a sizeable field, it is worth a look. The available report is brief, so check route and start details before you enter.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: The 14th Phnom Penh International Half Marathon was held on the morning of 14 June 2026 with almost 6,000 national and international runners [1].
It was organised to mark the 90th birthday of Her Majesty the Queen Mother, and Senior Minister Thong Khon, chairman of the National Olympic Committee of Cambodia, presided over the start [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2027 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want an international half marathon in Cambodia's capital. Fourteen editions in, it is an established event.

The one report on 2026 covers the ceremony rather than the course, so check the route map, start time and water stations when the 2027 details are published. June in Phnom Penh is hot and humid, so expect an early start.
This review is compiled from a published report on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Phnom Penh International Half Marathon in 2026?
faqs.answer: Almost 6,000 national and international runners took part in the 14th edition on 14 June 2026, according to Cambodia's national news agency.

faqs.question: Who organises the Phnom Penh International Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: It is held under the National Olympic Committee of Cambodia, whose chairman, Senior Minister Thong Khon, presided over the 2026 race. The 2026 edition marked the 90th birthday of the Queen Mother.

faqs.question: When is the Phnom Penh International Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: In June. The 14th edition was on 14 June 2026, and the 2027 race is scheduled for 13 June 2027.
